findings.issue: apiFetch returns null for any non-OK response, so API 500s/timeouts render the 'Not found' page instead of surfacing an error
findings.suggestion: Only return null on 404 (and treat other statuses as throw/error, e.g. via an error boundary or error.tsx)

findings.issue: 404 handling is hand-rolled: a catch-all route plus inline <NotFoundContent/> in each page, never calling notFound(), so responses are HTTP 200
findings.suggestion: Call notFound() from 'next/navigation' in the resource pages and delete the catch-all; root not-found.tsx then handles everything with a real 404 status

findings.issue: Triple/quadruple redundant no-cache config (layout segment config, per-page re-exports, fetch cache:'no-store')
findings.suggestion: Keep dynamic = 'force-dynamic' in the layout (or drop fetch cache:'no-store'); delete the per-page re-exports

findings.issue: Next 16.4 makes Cache Components the recommended model for new apps; this app is classic App Router with no recorded decision
findings.suggestion: Either adopt cacheComponents (all routes are dynamic anyway, impact is small) or leave a comment/config note explaining the choice

findings.issue: Pagination links are plain <a href>, causing full document reloads inconsistent with the client-side filtering elsewhere
findings.suggestion: Use next/link; server props already hydrate HomeBrowser from the URL

findings.issue: first() duplicated verbatim in app/app/pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:36; speciesById map built identically in three pages (moves/abilities/types)
findings.suggestion: Move first() into lib/format and add a getSpeciesByIdMap() helper in lib/api

findings.issue: EvolutionTree and EvolutionBranch are near-identical recursive components
findings.suggestion: Collapse into one recursive component (the tree wrapper adds only an outer <ul>)

findings.issue: type-badge class string inlined in MovesSection, moves page and types page although a TypeBadge component exists
findings.suggestion: Reuse TypeBadge (add the className prop) for consistency and single point of change

findings.issue: Module-level promise cache never evicts successful entries and is undocumented; future owners may be surprised by permanent staleness
findings.suggestion: Add a short comment stating the spec's runtime-caching allowance and the failure-eviction behavior (and consider a cap)

findings.issue: Type page loads all 18 type records plus the full species index to render one type
findings.suggestion: Fine today (cached, spec permits), but a getTypeRecord() export would make the page's actual dependency explicit

summary: A solidly idiomatic Next.js 16 App Router implementation with clean server-component data loading, correct metadata, and doc-prescribed URL-state patterns; I'd merge after one round of nits. The real asks are to use the framework's notFound() flow instead of a hand-rolled catch-all, stop rendering API errors as 'Not found', and de-duplicate a handful of small helpers. Nothing structural needs rework.
